ui_bugs.issue: The route is nested inside the !IS_USER_BUILD admin-only block. In the Android user build, this route is not registered, matching the user-reported blank page in APK even though it works on the web/admin preview build.

The defensive pay-store-loading-state exists in the component source, but direct navigation without a user through App redirects to /login, so that guard state is not reachable through the normal route condition.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA: The Android Play Store build uses REACT_APP_BUILD_TYPE=user. In App.js the /pay-partner-store route is currently declared inside the block guarded by !IS_USER_BUILD && AdminLayout, along with admin routes. Therefore the web preview can render /pay-partner-store, but the APK user build does not register the route, leaving only the shell/top/bottom navigation or a blank page. Dashboard ad overlap appears addressed in source by removing the page-level AdMobBanner and using GlobalBannerAd hide list + 90dp margin, but physical APK overlay verification was not possible in this environment.
